{/* Section 1: Title Header */}
Engineering & Tailoring

Our Services & Solutions

Detailed breakdown of bespoke tailoring services, mosquito mesh installation, and track engineering.

{/* Section 2: Hardware Showcase */}

Track & Mounting Hardware Architecture

Engineered support systems for effortless drape glides and bug netting installation

Heavy Aluminum Tracks

Rust-proof dual/triple rail channels for combined sheer and blackout drapes.

Recessed Ceiling Channels

Concealed architectural track slots built flush into modern false ceilings.

Magnetic Mesh Frames

Snug magnetic perimeter strip locking for zero gap mosquito protection.

{/* Deep Service 1 */}

1. Bespoke Curtain Tailoring Service

Hand-stitched drapes designed precisely around your room's ceiling height, floor clearance, and window width. We craft pinch pleat, box pleat, ripplefold, and grommet eyelet styles.

  • Double-bottom weighted hems for linear vertical drops
  • Custom lining attachments (Sheer, Satin, or Thermal)
  • Reinforced heading tapes for long-lasting pleat structural memory
{/* Deep Service 2 */}

2. Mosquito Screen Door & Window Systems

Engineered protection against mosquitoes, flies, and pests without blocking outdoor sunlight or fresh air flow.

  • Pleated Accordion Sliding Nets for French doors & balconies
  • Velcro-detachable washable mesh frames for easy cleaning
  • High-strength SS304 anti-claw pet mesh options
{/* Deep Service 3 */}

3. Thermal & Sound Blackout Installation

Specially coated 3-pass blackout linings sewn directly into your main drapes to keep bedrooms pitch black and energy efficient.

  • 100% Light cutoff ideal for night-shift sleep & home theaters
  • Blocks up to 40% solar heat transfer to reduce AC bills
  • Acoustic deadening layers to mute outdoor traffic noises
{/* Service Warranty Matrix */}
